label: About
title: About Green Fuselage Felt Wall
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 76 recent saved-signal files and 72 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @archivepilled: Nicolò Pucci di Benisichi, 'Biliardo con aereo' (2026) and @TheRujiK: I made a monster generator. Every monster is procedurally created and animated., plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Green Fuselage Felt Wall: Surreal billiards poster wall, torn-wall camera grammar: a dominant emerald aircraft-like band slices across the upper third, blurred into chalk-gray ceiling diagonals, while an aqua felt trapezoid widens from bottom center toward smeared right-edge silhouettes. Dense pasted archive fragments, cream borders, stains,... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against long emerald horizontal smear across the upper-middle, pale torn greenhouse-like patch at upper right, and vertical ripped paper seam left of center.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
